question: How much arrives in your account each month?
why: Your plan is built from what you actually receive, so use the amount that lands in your account rather than your salary before deductions.

question: How much money do you already have that this plan may use?
why: Only what you enter here is used. It goes toward your goals first, so they need less each month. Lower it at any time and the next plan hands the money back.
